Our story
years of experience in the real estate sector
years since HousySpace was born

items.title: Today
items.text: we keep growing with those who choose us again and recommend us
HousySpace was born five years ago from a very simple idea: **in every property transaction, people always come first.**
We had spent years in the industry and knew what could be done differently.
We wanted sincere closeness, truly personal attention, and for every client to feel that their worries were ours too.

That is how HousySpace came about: not to be just another estate agency, but a project true to how we understand this profession, with empathy, honesty, dedication and a commitment that goes beyond closing a deal.
Behind every property there is a story, an important decision and people who trust us.
It gives us great satisfaction to share the joy of someone finding their first home, to help a family begin a new chapter, or to accompany a client in making the right decision.
Five years later we keep growing with the same philosophy, thanks to those who choose us again and recommend us.
Our philosophy
Real estate consultants, not just sellers.
We advise you on how to do it, whether it suits you and when is the best moment, and we make sure everything you do is correct and safe.
That you are happy at every step, **not only when you sign**.
We help you with everything, whatever happens

items.title: We solve whatever comes up

items.title: A network of professionals
items.text: A single point of entry: we coordinate the rest.
An extra mile
Always an **extra mile**
Everything an estate agency does, and everything that is needed on top.
Many transactions fall through because of an unforeseen problem that nobody knew how to solve. We anticipate, and when it appears, we solve it in the most ingenious and effective way.
Even if it does not depend on us or we cannot solve it directly, our answer is always the same:
Don't worry, I'll take care of it.
We get ahead of the unexpected.
We solve it when it appears.
You are calm and happy at every step.
**We will do whatever it takes in your transaction so that you end up happy.**
What sets us apart
We do not aim to manage the largest possible number of properties.
We prefer to give each client the time, attention and effort they deserve, with a **close, transparent and truly personal approach**.
How we work
We are passionate about our work.
The road travelled
For us, success is simple: **doing our work well** and making sure our clients are satisfied with the road travelled.
From start to finish
We get involved in every transaction, look for a solution when difficulties arise and stand by the client from the very first moment to the end of the process.
Our commitment
Our greatest satisfaction is knowing that those who have trusted us **would do so again**.
HousySpace. Property Solutions.
Collaboration with industry professionals
Surrounding ourselves with the best is also part of our philosophy.
Over the years we have built a network of professionals specialised in legal advice, architecture, interior design, renovations and other fields linked to housing and property.
Every collaboration stems from experience, trust and a shared way of understanding work: **providing a close, rigorous service committed to each client.**
Our criterion is simple: **we work with professionals we ourselves would trust.**
For us, saying «Don't worry, I'll take care of it» means having the people, the knowledge and the will needed to make it happen.
